about: Recovered provenance for an archived evaluation run. This file is NOT harness output. It is written by hand, and it is kept separate from run_config.json for exactly that reason: putting a hand-recovered value into the harness's own output would make it read as something the harness recorded. See the recovered-vs-recorded rule in docs/en/Honesty_Constraints.md.
verdict_written_at_source: The eval harness writes no timestamp anywhere in its output, which is why this file exists rather than a run_config.json field. The value is the mtime of h1_report.json as the generator read it at commit 9d4cd5b, while mtimes in this tree were still the ones the run left behind; a later checkout overwrote every mtime under results/eval-real/ with the checkout time.
verdict_written_at_means: The moment h1_report.json was written to disk. That is not the same claim as 'the date of the run': a run spanning midnight would make the two differ, and nothing available here can tell them apart.
what_is_not_here: The harness did not record the models, EMBEDDING_DIM, or groundedness threshold. The display and guardrail fields below are recovered metadata for this archived run, not harness output.

sparse_retrieval.basis: The archived harness config did not record a sparse implementation. This run predates okapi_bm25_v1, and its B1/B3/B4 sparse route was the repository's ILIKE candidate filter plus fixed _chunk_rank substring bonuses.
sparse_retrieval.not_bm25: It did not compute corpus document frequency, IDF, term-frequency saturation, or document-length normalization.
